kernels.name: argmax
kernels.kernel: __global__ void argmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ vals, int* __restrict__ idxs, int stride){ extern __shared__ float svals[]; extern __shared__ int sidx[]; int tid = threadIdx.x; int base = blockIdx.x * stride; float best = -FLT_MAX; int best_i = -1; for (int i = tid; i < stride; i += blockDim.x) { float v = x[base + i]; if (v > best) { best = v; best_i = i; } } svals[tid] = best; sidx[tid] = best_i; __syncthreads(); for (int s = blockDim.x>>1; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s && svals[tid+s] > svals[tid]) { svals[tid] = svals[tid+s]; sidx[tid] = sidx[tid+s]; } __syncthreads(); } if (tid == 0) { vals[blockIdx.x] = svals[0]; idxs[blockIdx.x] = sidx[0]; } }

kernels.name: prefix_sum_scan
kernels.kernel: __global__ void scan_kernel(const int* __restrict__ x, int* __restrict__ out){ extern __shared__ int temp[]; int th = threadIdx.x; int offset = 1; temp[2*th] = x[2*th]; temp[2*th+1] = x[2*th+1]; for (int d = blockDim.x; d > 0; d >>= 1) { __syncthreads(); if (th < d) { int ai = offset*(2*th+1)-1; int bi = offset*(2*th+2)-1; temp[bi] += temp[ai]; } offset *= 2; } if (th == 0) temp[2*blockDim.x-1] = 0; for (int d = 1; d < 2*blockDim.x; d <<= 1) { offset >>= 1; __syncthreads(); if (th < d) { int ai = offset*(2*th+1)-1; int bi = offset*(2*th+2)-1; int t = temp[ai]; temp[ai] = temp[bi]; temp[bi] += t; } } __syncthreads(); out[2*th] = temp[2*th]; out[2*th+1] = temp[2*th+1]; }

kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q){ int n = blockIdx.z; int k = blockIdx.y; int p = blockIdx.x / Q; int q = blockIdx.x % Q; int tid = threadIdx.x; float acc = b ? b[k] : 0.0f; for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) for (int s = 0; s < S; ++s) { int h = p + r, w_ = q + s; if (h < H && w_ < W) acc += x[((n*C+c)*H + h)*W + w_] * w[((k*C+c)*R + r)*S + s]; } if (tid == 0) y[((n*K + k)*P + p)*Q + q] = acc; }

kernels.name: max_pool2d_forward
kernels.kernel: __global__ void maxpool2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int KH, int KW, int P, int Q){ int n = blockIdx.z; int c = blockIdx.y; int p = blockIdx.x / Q; int q = blockIdx.x % Q; float m = -FLT_MAX; for (int kh = 0; kh < KH; ++kh) for (int kw = 0; kw < KW; ++kw) { int h = p + kh, w_ = q + kw; if (h < H && w_ < W) m = fmaxf(m, x[((n*C+c)*H + h)*W + w_]); } y[((n*C + c)*P + p)*Q + q] = m; }

kernels.name: avg_pool2d_forward
kernels.kernel: __global__ void avgpool2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int KH, int KW, int P, int Q){ int n = blockIdx.z; int c = blockIdx.y; int p = blockIdx.x / Q; int q = blockIdx.x % Q; float sum = 0.0f; int cnt = 0; for (int kh = 0; kh < KH; ++kh) for (int kw = 0; kw < KW; ++kw) { int h = p + kh, w_ = q + kw; if (h < H && w_ < W) { sum += x[((n*C+c)*H + h)*W + w_]; cnt++; } } y[((n*C + c)*P + p)*Q + q] = sum / cnt; }

kernels.name: softmax
kernels.kernel: __global__ void softmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int n){ extern __shared__ float smem[]; int tid = threadIdx.x; float maxv = -FLT_MAX; for (int i = tid; i < n; i += blockDim.x) maxv = fmaxf(maxv, x[i]); smem[tid] = maxv; __syncthreads(); for (int s = blockDim.x>>1; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s) smem[tid] = fmaxf(smem[tid], smem[tid+s]); __syncthreads(); } maxv = smem[0]; float sum = 0.0f; for (int i = tid; i < n; i += blockDim.x) sum += expf(x[i] - maxv); smem[tid] = sum; __syncthreads(); for (int s = blockDim.x>>1; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s) smem[tid] += smem[tid+s]; __syncthreads(); } float denom = smem[0]; for (int i = tid; i < n; i += blockDim.x) y[i] = expf(x[i] - maxv) / denom; }

kernels.name: batchnorm_forward
kernels.pytorch: y = torch.batch_norm(x, running_mean, running_var, weight, bias, training)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void batchnorm_fw_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, const float* __restrict__ mean, const float* __restrict__ var, const float* __restrict__ gamma, const float* __restrict__ beta, float eps, int N){ int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (idx < N) { float norm = (x[idx] - mean[0]) * rsqrtf(var[0] + eps); y[idx] = gamma[0]*norm + beta[0]; } }

kernels.name: layernorm_forward
kernels.pytorch: y = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, normalized_shape, weight, bias, eps)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void layernorm_fw_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, const float* __restrict__ gamma, const float* __restrict__ beta, int M, int N, float eps){ extern __shared__ float sm[]; int row = blockIdx.x; int tid = threadIdx.x; float mean = 0.0f; for (int i = tid; i < N; i += blockDim.x) mean += x[row*N + i]; sm[tid] = mean; __syncthreads(); for (int s = blockDim.x>>1; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s) sm[tid] += sm[tid+s]; __syncthreads(); } mean = sm[0] / N; float var = 0.0f; for (int i = tid; i < N; i += blockDim.x) { float d = x[row*N + i] - mean; var += d*d; } sm[tid] = var; __syncthreads(); for (int s = blockDim.x>>1; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s) sm[tid] += sm[tid+s]; __syncthreads(); } var = sm[0] / N; float inv = rsqrtf(var + eps); for (int i = tid; i < N; i += blockDim.x) { float nrm = (x[row*N + i] - mean) * inv; y[row*N + i] = nrm * gamma[i] + beta[i]; } }

(1.0f/(1.0f-p)) : 0.0f; y[idx] = x[idx] * sc; } }

kernels.kernel: __global__ void dot_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out, int N){ extern __shared__ float sdata[]; unsigned int tid = threadIdx.x; unsigned int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x * 2 + tid; float sum = 0.0f; if (i < N) sum = a[i]*b[i] + ((i+blockDim.x < N) ? a[i+blockDim.x]*b[i+blockDim.x] : 0.0f); sdata[tid] = sum; __syncthreads(); for (unsigned int s = blockDim.x/2; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (tid < s) sdata[tid] += sdata[tid + s]; __syncthreads(); } if (tid == 0) atomicAdd(out, sdata[0]); }

kernels.kernel: __global__ void batched_gemm_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ B, float* __restrict__ C, int Batches, int M, int N, int K){ int b = blockIdx.z; int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (b < Batches && row < M && col < N) { const float* A_batch = A + b*M*K; const float* B_batch = B + b*K*N; float sum = 0.0f; for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) sum += A_batch[row*K + k] * B_batch[k*N + col]; C[(b*M + row)*N + col] = sum; } }

kernels.name: conv_transposed_2d

kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv_transpose2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q, int sh, int sw, int ph, int pw, int dh, int dw){ int n = blockIdx.z; int k = blockIdx.y; int p = blockIdx.x / Q; int q = blockIdx.x % Q; float sum = b ? b[k] : 0.0f; for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) for (int s = 0; s < S; ++s) { int h = (p + ph - r*dh); int w_ = (q + pw - s*dw); if (h % sh==0 && w_ % sw==0) { h /= sh; w_ /= sw; if (h>=0 && h<H && w_>=0 && w_<W) sum += x[((n*C+c)*H + h)*W + w_] * w[((c*K+k)*R + r)*S + s]; } } y[((n*K+k)*P + p)*Q + q] = sum; }

kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv2d_asym_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q, int sh, int sw, int ph, int pw, int dh, int dw){ int n = blockIdx.z; int k = blockIdx.y; int p = blockIdx.x / Q; int q = blockIdx.x % Q; float sum = b ? b[k] : 0.0f; for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) for (int s = 0; s < S; ++s) { int h = p*sh - ph + r*dh; int w_ = q*sw - pw + s*dw; if (h>=0 && h<H && w_>=0 && w_<W) sum += x[((n*C+c)*H + h)*W + w_] * w[((k*C+c)*R + r)*S + s]; } y[((n*K+k)*P + p)*Q + q] = sum; }

kernels.name: conv_transposed_1d
kernels.pytorch: out = torch.nn.functional.conv_transpose1d(x, weight, bias, stride, padding, dilation)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv_transpose1d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int L, int K, int R, int P, int s, int p, int d){ int n = blockIdx.z; int k = blockIdx.y; int pos = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (pos < P) { float sum = b ? b[k] : 0.0f; for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) { int l = (pos + p - r*d); if (l % s == 0) { l /= s; if (l>=0 && l< L) sum += x[(n*C+c)*L + l] * w[(c*K+k)*R + r]; } } y[(n*K+k)*P + pos] = sum; } }
